title: Generic nondegeneracy of constant mean curvature radial graphs
summary: Given a smooth domain $D\subset\mathbb S^{N-1}$, $N\geq 3$, and a positive constant $H$, we study radial graphs over $D$ with constant mean curvature $H$ which meet orthogonally the boundary of the cone spanned by $D$. The corresponding problem is given by a quasilinear elliptic equation on $D$ with homogeneous Neumann boundary condition. We investigate the structure of the solution set under smooth perturbations of the domain which are parametrized by an open set of $C^{3,α}$-diffeomorphisms of the sphere.
